request: Bryce asked what the 'Editing' thumbnail and label in the composer were (C43 composer 932:107235) and said they did not make sense there: redesign it if it is needed, otherwise remove it (via /design:design-critique).
whatItIs: The edit source: the exact picture an image-edit request will change. A new picture's follow-up draft targets it (C40-C42), and the viewer can show a different picture from the one being edited (C05, C54), so the composer has to show it. Clicking it opens the media picker to change it (C54 -> C43); its Remove badge stops editing.
critique: It sat after Reference and Sketch in the same 72 x 48 tile with the same muted caption, so the row read as three peer tools and 'Editing' looked like a selected mode rather than the picture the words will change.
Reference and Sketch are the two ways to give a request its picture (bring one, draw one). Beside a picture that is already there they read as rival modes, not things you add.
The caption repeated the Edit image button, and 'Editing' reads like a running status.
The picture the request is about was a 50 x 28 sliver, the smallest thing in the composer, with the Remove badge straddling its corner.
Not ready and Unavailable still showed the desk picture with a different caption, although neither state has a picture yet.

C24's point, that a picture taken from another conversation brings none of that conversation's history, cannot be seen; on screen it was an edit with a second picture and two role labels. C26 restated the composer's picture as the old 'Desk · v1 / Image to edit' pill in an otherwise empty Another variation sheet.

design.tile: Compact input fills its 72 x 48 tile with the picture (radius/control) and has no caption. The Remove badge (2202:9788) sits inside the top-right corner at x 52, y 4, so nothing pokes outside the tile; code still needs a 24px hit area.
design.row: An image edit's media row holds only that tile. Reference and Sketch come back when the picture is removed; the media picker the tile opens has Upload for replacing it.
